name: Meikoku Gakuen Taidou Hen "Onegai Shimasu... Sensei no Seieki de, Watashi-tachi o Haramasete Hoshiin Desu…♡"
original_name: 冥刻學園 胎動編「お願いします…先生の精液で、私達を孕ませて欲しいんです…♡」
source:
An abnormal phenomenon called "Dark Hour" has been occurring at Jinguu Gakuen.

--People who are affected by the "Dark Hour" have their rationality knocked out of their grasp, and they are dominated by their carnal desires.
The explanation for this phenomenon was added: "If you try to resist this urge and continue to endure it, you will die.
Asada Shin could not believe these words for a moment.
However, he was soon confronted with the reality of the situation.
He reaffirms his role as "called upon to save those at the school".

As if to mock Asada, the situation was more serious than he thought.
One day, when he was relieved that he had not met the worst possible end due to the "dark hour," he was called back to the school to help save the school students.
He was headed for a town he had not been for a while because he lived in the school.

There, he saw a world where people without reason are spreading due to the underworld.
Why did the Meikoku have to spread outside of the school?
Asada was almost crushed by these questions, but the situation pushed him further.

The story of "Meikoku" finally comes to a conclusion at the end of a series of complicated intentions set in a women's school.
translation:
一种名为“暗时”的异常现象正在冥刻学园发生。

——受到“暗时”影响的人会失去理智，被肉欲支配。
对此现象的解释是：“如果你试图抵抗这种冲动、继续忍耐下去，就会死亡。”

浅田真无法相信这些话。
然而，他很快便不得不面对现实。
他再次确认了自己的职责：“拯救学校里那些被召唤而来的人”。

仿佛为了嘲弄浅田，事态比他想象中更加严重。
某天，他庆幸自己没有因“暗时”迎来最糟糕的结局，却被召回学校，帮助拯救学生。
由于住在学校里，他前往了一个已经许久未曾造访的城镇。

在那里，他看见了一个因冥界扩散、理性尽失的人们不断增加的世界。
为什么“暗时”必须扩散到校外？
这些问题几乎压垮了浅田，但事态将他进一步推向前方。

在女子学校中交织的复杂意图最终迎来结局，《冥刻学园》的故事也终于走到了终点。
